objections.about: The reply says generating an API key ends the free trial and starts a paid Starter subscription. That is an unlikely and risky way to start paying, and it could charge the customer or end their trial early. It also assumes the Starter plan, which the customer never mentioned.

The customer asked how to start paying before the trial ends Friday. The reply only says the Billing Portal is for managing a subscription. It never says where or how to pick a plan and enter payment details, and it doesn't say what happens on Friday.
